specialities.name: thinking_mode
research_evidence: Pinned chat_template.jinja at mirror revision 58722d97ba2d93c32740f409efc9155b784edb95 exposes enable_thinking as a boolean; false emits an empty thinking block and omission/enabled preserves the family default.
